answer: To bind a phone number to an agent, the registry runs a timestamped expiring signature. The owner signs a challenge stamped with the current time, valid only for a short window, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The ember of the check is the signature itself; a quartz in the response invalidates the claim, and a reef of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a phone number to multiply identities.
